_doc: What the game says when a hit meets a creature's weakness, its resistance or what it shrugs off, or fire puts a beast to flight (src/affinity.py; Brandon, bug bash 3.3.2: 'a whole set of pokemon style messages, so you know it when you are blocked or effective'). One line per action, chosen at random from the pool; the _many pools when several creatures were struck the same way. KNOWLEDGE DECIDES WHAT IS SAID (winning-build plan 2026-11-13, section 3.1; Brandon: 'no omniscient monsters'): the hero always FEELS a hit; knowing the creature tells him WHY. A kind he does not know (family_lore.knowledge UNKNOWN) gets a 'felt' line, which never names what met it. A kind he knows only by its family (KIN) gets the felt line and the family's habit from 'habits'. A kind he knows (KNOWN: studied, its page opened, or its family at Lore) gets the top-level pools, which name the cause. {name} is the creature with its article at a sentence start, {the} the same mid-sentence, {word} what met it (fire, silver, a cutting blow). A 'felt' line never uses {word}. A fire fright is what the eye sees (the beast backs off from the flame) and is said the same at every level. status_immune: the line when an effect cannot take hold on a creature by its nature (Monster.add_effect, status_immune in monsters.json), by effect, said to a hero who knows the creature or its family; status_immune_felt: the same for a creature he does not know, which never says why. status_immune_will: the same for a refusal that is not the kind's nature but a named foe's will (a boss, a mini-boss or a seal demon is never frightened, charmed or, for a boss, held fast: Monster.resists_control) or the galla's fury (fearless), so a creature with a mind is never said to have none. status_weak: the line when one takes hold easily (status_weak), which is what the eye sees. {effect} is the effect's name.
weak: Super effective! {name} cannot bear {word}.

Right where it hurts! {word_cap} finds {the}'s weakness.
{name} shrieks. It was never made to take {word}.
A telling blow! {name} has no answer to {word}.
{word_cap} bites deep. {name} is weak to it!
That is the way to hurt {the}: {word}!

{word_cap} barely troubles {the}.
{name} hardly notices. Try something other than {word}.

{name} was made to weather {word}. Not very effective.
{name} turns {word} aside. Not very effective.
shrugs_off: {name} shrugs off {word}. Almost nothing gets through.
{word_cap} goes through {the} like a hand through smoke.
Hardly a scratch! {name} was never going to fall to {word}.
{name} does not even slow down. {word_cap} is the wrong tool here.
Next to useless: {word} hardly touches {the}.

They shy from the flame and scatter!

habits._doc: The family's habit, said after the felt line to a hero who knows the creature's family but not the kind itself (KIN). Written from the family's (or its group's) lore in data/family_affinity.json. A key 'weak:slash' is the habit when a cutting blow met a weakness; several words share a key with commas ('resisted:slash,pierce'). The creature's group is asked first, then its family; then the family's plain 'weak', 'resisted' or 'shrugs_off' line, which names nothing. tests/test_know_your_enemy.py checks that every keyed habit is true of most of the kinds it speaks for.

resisted:pierce: The dead have no heart for a point to find.
A thrust finds nothing in the dead to kill.
weak:slash: The old way with the dead is to take the head.
The dead have always fallen to the blade that takes the head.
weak:holy: The dead cannot bear what is holy.
What is holy burns the restless dead.
weak:silver,elven_silver,silverbark: The dead have always hated silver.
weak:fire: Fire is the old end of the dead: what was beheaded was burned.
resisted:cold: The dead are cold already; frost has little to take.
resisted:poison: Poison needs living blood, and the dead have none.
weak: Even the dead have something they cannot bear.
resisted: The dead feel little of what would fell a living man.
shrugs_off: Some of the dead are hardly there at all.

resisted:slash,pierce,blunt: A blade passes through a ghost as through mist.
Ordinary blows are mostly wasted on a ghost.
weak:holy: Holy power is what lays a ghost.
weak:fire: Fire lays a ghost, as the old priests knew.
resisted:cold: A ghost is made of the grave's own cold.
resisted:poison: A ghost has no blood for poison to ride.
weak: Every ghost has the thing that lays it.
resisted: Much of a ghost is no more than mist.
shrugs_off: Much of a ghost is no more than mist.

weak:pierce: A vampire is ended with a stake through the heart.
weak:holy: The undead lords shrink from holy things.
weak:silver,elven_silver,silverbark: The undead lords have always hated silver.
weak:fire: Fire and sunlight were always the vampire's end.
resisted:cold: The undead lords are as cold as their tombs.
resisted:poison: Poison needs living blood, and theirs stopped long ago.
resisted:drain: The undead lords take life; they do not give it up.
weak: For all their pride, the undead lords have old fears.
resisted: The undead lords shrug off what would kill a living man.
shrugs_off: The undead lords shrug off what would kill a living man.

weak:holy: Fiends of the pit cannot bear what is holy.
weak:cold_iron: Cold iron has always burned the fiends.
resisted:fire: A fiend was born in fire; it does not fear the flame.
resisted:poison: Poison is the pit's own drink; it does not trouble a fiend.
weak: Every fiend has a thing it cannot stand.
resisted: A fiend wears its flesh like a coat, and feels little through it.
shrugs_off: A fiend wears its flesh like a coat, and feels little through it.

weak:pierce: A thrust finds the gap in a dragon's scales.
Sigurd stabbed Fafnir from below: a point is what kills a dragon.
resisted:fire: A dragon breathes fire and does not burn.
weak:dragonbone,dragonwood,petrified_dra: Dragon bone bites dragon scale where steel will not.
weak: Even a dragon has its bare patch.
resisted: Dragon scales turn most of what strikes them.
shrugs_off: Dragon scales turn most of what strikes them.

weak:titanforged: The titans' own metal was made to bring giants down.
weak: The bigger they are, the harder they fall to the right blow.
resisted: A giant's hide is as thick as bark.
shrugs_off: A giant hardly feels what would kill a man.

weak: Goblinkin are flesh like men: the right blow hurts them as it would anyone.

shrugs_off: Goblinkin trust their armour more than their luck.

weak: Men and women bleed like anyone.
resisted: Armour is the only thing that turns a blow on a man.
shrugs_off: Armour is the only thing that turns a blow on a man.

weak:iron,cold_iron: The fair folk have always feared iron.
weak: The fair folk are quick and clever, but they keep their old fears.
resisted: The fair folk slip aside from much of what strikes them.
shrugs_off: The fair folk slip aside from much of what strikes them.

weak: Flesh and fur: a beast feels a good blow like any living thing.
resisted: A great beast's hide is thick, and turns some of it.
shrugs_off: A great beast's hide is thick, and turns most of it.

weak: Small things: the right blow ends them.
resisted: Some small things wear armour of their own.
shrugs_off: Ten thousand small things cannot be cut like one big one.

weak:dragonbone: Dragon bone bites scale where steel will not.
weak: Scale and cold blood: a serpent has its soft places.
resisted: Scale turns some of it.
shrugs_off: Scale turns most of it.

weak:pierce: An arrow brings a bird down: birds are light and hollow-boned.

resisted: Feathers and speed turn some of it aside.
shrugs_off: Feathers and speed turn most of it aside.

resisted:poison: The gorgons' blood is venom; poison does not hurt them.
weak: Under the scales a gorgon is flesh, as Perseus found.

shrugs_off: Scale and stony skin turn most of it.

weak: Every monster of the old stories fell in its own way.

shrugs_off: The monsters of the stories are not beaten the ordinary way.

resisted: A shapeshifter's body is not quite real.
shrugs_off: A shapeshifter's body is not quite real.

weak:blunt: A hammer cracks a made thing.
resisted:slash,pierce: A blade skates off a made thing, or sticks fast.
resisted:poison: A made thing has no blood for poison.
weak: Every made thing has a flaw its maker left in it.
resisted: Bronze, iron, clay or stone: a made thing does not bleed.
shrugs_off: Bronze, iron, clay or stone: a made thing does not bleed.

resisted:slash,pierce: Living fire, air and water close behind a blade.

resisted: An elemental closes behind a blow like a wound that was never there.
shrugs_off: An elemental's own element cannot harm it.

shrugs_off: Things from outside the world are not hurt the way we are.

weak:slash: An axe fells what an arrow cannot.

weak:fire: Dry wood goes up like kindling.
resisted:poison: A plant has no blood for poison.
